description: Phase 10C.5 seed list: GSE component manuals from the owner's library (paths are relative to the library root, on the dev machine 'Reference/GSE diagnostic apps'). Each manual has a self-authored acceptance question set: a hit = a top-k result from THIS manual whose page_start is an expected page, searched across the whole seeded library (BM25-only when no embedding model). Questions were written from the same PDF text layer the pages were read from, so this is an in-sample regression check, not a retrieval-quality benchmark. 'slow' manuals take minutes to read and only run when GSE_RAG_SLOW=1.
